parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by excluding the Random function from group by clauses, but it may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch may break other queries that rely on the current behavior of including non-aggregate, non-ref order_by expressions in group by clauses.
The patch introduces a new method `get_group_by_cols` which is not used in the provided diff and may be confusing.
